correctness.rationale: The unique reduced odd-dyadic characterization is derived from both normal and subnormal exponent ranges. Doubling reduces denominator depth by exactly one, so each first-hitting time is its depth; counting admissible odd numerators gives the full histogram and N. Explicit depth-shift preimages establish full image sets at each time and hence the exact piecewise support count. Finite sum identities produce the cumulative equal-state absorption law, including p=1,E=1 and all branch boundaries. An exponent/mantissa enumerator independently checked all statewise first-hitting times and image sets for 43 finite formats; symbolic proof handles all p,E≥1.
